summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K responding to rumors of a potential acquisition of Lotte Insurance. The filing states the group continues to review measures to enhance non-bank competitiveness but has made no decision; further disclosure will occur when matters are determined or within three months. No terms, price, premium, or advisors are disclosed. This is a follow-up to an initial undetermined response from June 29, 2026. The filing is a routine rumor acknowledgment, not a definitive agreement. The deal is speculative; watch for a definitive agreement or expiration of the three-month disclosure window.
